title.narrative: Strengthening MHPSS of Children in Crisis-Affected Lebanon

description.narrative: Lebanon’s education sector continues to be impacted by compounded crises, including economic collapse, protracted displacement and recurrent security shocks, resulting in significant learning disruptions and heightened mental health and psychosocial needs among learners. The project aims to support learner well-being and engagement by integrating mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) approaches through Greening Education interventions. The intended outcome is improved psychosocial well-being and civic engagement of crisis-affected learners. Key outputs focus on the delivery of Greening Education activities with an embedded MHPSS lens. Key activities include the organisation of visits for a minimum of 480 crisis-affected public-school students from all over Lebanon to the Green Demonstration Room in Jounieh, Lebanon, where learners will participate in hands-on, experiential and practical activities designed to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being, environmental awareness, positive coping mechanisms and active civic engagement
